facts.label: Minimum in‑office anchor days per week
facts.quote: Minimum 2 anchor days in office (Tue/Thu by default).

facts.label: Maximum work‑from‑anywhere days per year
facts.quote: Work from anywhere. New: up to 20 days/year "work from anywhere" within the employee's country, with manager approval.

facts.label: Work‑from‑home allowed only on company‑managed devices
facts.quote: WFH is permitted only on Northwind-managed, MDM-enrolled devices connected via Northwind VPN.
